value.name: administrator escorts Asha to room
value.description: The administrator leads Asha down the corridor and stops at her father's half-open door, letting her enter alone.
evidence: The administrator led her down a corridor that smelled faintly of warmed food and disinfectant, stopped at a half-open door, and stepped back to let Asha go in alone.

value.name: Asha hesitates before entering
value.description: Asha pauses at the threshold, takes a breath, and steels herself before going into the room.
evidence: Asha paused on the threshold with the bag still over her wrist and took one slow breath before she crossed it.

value.name: Asha sees her sleeping father
value.description: Inside the room, Asha finds her father asleep in bed under a thin blanket and notices how long it has been since she last saw him in person.
evidence: The room held a single bed against the far wall, a chair pulled close, and her father under a thin blanket, turned slightly toward the window with his mouth a little open in sleep.
She had not seen him in person in almost four years

value.name: Asha notices father's hand
value.description: Asha focuses on the shape of her father's hand and remembers it from earlier parts of her life.
evidence: the first thing she noticed was not the hospital details she had been cataloguing all afternoon but the shape of his hand on top of the blanket, the knuckles she remembered from a steering wheel, from the back of a kitchen chair.

value.name: Asha sets bag down quietly
value.description: Asha places her bag on the floor beside the chair and remains standing for a moment, not ready to sit yet.
evidence: She set the bag down quietly on the floor by the chair and stayed standing a moment longer, not yet ready to sit.

value.name: Asha sits beside father
value.description: Asha slowly sits in the chair next to her father's bed and reaches for his hand.
evidence: Asha sat down slowly in the chair beside the bed and set her hand on top of her father's

value.name: Asha recalls childhood chair
value.description: Touching her father's hand triggers Asha's memory of the kitchen chair he used to drag closer when he wanted to talk.
evidence: her thumb finding the ridge of the knuckle she remembered from the back of the kitchen chair he used to drag closer to the table when he wanted to talk to her.

value.name: Asha feels father's changed body
value.description: Asha notices her father's skin is warmer and looser than expected, and he remains asleep.
evidence: His skin was warmer than she expected, and looser, and he did not wake.

value.name: Asha observes father's fragile breathing
value.description: Asha stays with him long enough to notice his uneven breathing, a tremor in his lip, and the gray at his hairline.
evidence: She stayed like that long enough to notice the way his breathing caught and resumed, the small tremor in his lower lip, the gray at the edge of his hairline she had not seen up close in years.

value.name: Asha's phone interrupts moment
value.description: Asha's phone lights up with a message, interrupting the quiet reunion.
evidence: Her phone lit against her thigh with a messag
